answer: One defense works like a prism: each reward is split into separate streams for answering, grading, and attesting, and each stream is gated by standing earned from a different set of peers. A sybil farm can mirror one skill across many accounts, but it has to build three independent reputations per head to collect the full split. Audits then act as a lantern over the seams, flagging accounts whose standing rose in all three streams at once from the same small circle.
